name: Kimberley Forman
summary: Kimberley Forman is a Director of O’Sullivan Sneddon Law and a former Director of Shand Taylor Lawyers. She holds a Bachelor of Laws (First Class Honours) and a Bachelor of Behavioural Science (Psychology), and has more than 20 years’ experience in the legal industry, with significant expertise in the intellectual property and dispute resolution law.
